correctness.rationale: The face-classification reduces all 244 nonempty faces to eight star simplices and sixteen exceptional triangles. Their signed attaching map D:Z^16->Z^20 has displayed rank-13 unimodular minor, and the three listed integer nullvectors have identity coordinates 12,14,15, establishing the entire primitive integral kernel, not just a rational span. Signed actions on those cells give the explicit R and S with R^4=S^2=SRSR=I. A primitive four-element orbit sums to zero and any three form a unimodular basis; Smith invariants of R-I are (1,1,4), and modulo 2 nilpotent ranks 2,1,0. The star graph nerve plus Braun homology concentration justifies degree restrictions. Independent reconstruction found 20 chords, 16 admissible triples, boundary rank 13, kernel rank 3 and det(R-I)=-4.
residual_risks: The integral module is specific to the eight-point parameter; finite computation is exhaustive for that finite object, not a statement for larger stable Kneser graphs.
